narrative: Material PL2__M79D742F exhibits smooth, predominantly continuous daily demand averaging 5,204 units over 237 working days, with a right-skewed distribution and moderate CV of 0.66. Lead times are short (mean 1.56 days) but moderately variable (CV 0.54), with a bimodal pattern suggesting two delivery modes. No statistically significant trend was detected. An (r,Q) continuous-review policy with EOQ-sized replenishments of 140,192 units and a safety stock of 9,216 units achieves the 95% service level while reducing total annual inventory costs by 80.1% compared to the current SAP policy.
warnings: Storage capacity constrains order quantity: unconstrained EOQ (139,867) rounded up to MOQ and capped at remaining storage. Final order_quantity=140,192 satisfies safety_stock+order_quantity=149,408 <= max_storage_units=174,380.

research_insights.selection_rationale: Demand is smooth and predominantly non-zero, making a continuous-review (r,Q) policy appropriate. Short lead times reduce exposure to stockout during replenishment cycles. EOQ minimizes total ordering plus holding cost given high annual volume and low unit cost.
research_insights.boundary_risk: Storage cap at 174,380 units limits the order batch; at 85.7% utilization there is adequate headroom. If mean demand increases by more than ~17%, the effective EOQ would push against capacity and require either a capacity increase or more frequent smaller orders.
